comment: The two deployments of one shell, each on its own loopback port. Read by fixture_server.py, playwright.config.js and shell.spec.js, so the port map has exactly one source of truth. Ports sit above the Workbench's own 8765 and clear of the companion harness's 8791-8803.

local.description: The laptop: LocalProvider over the plan corpus on disk, addressed by path, reads open and a token held for writes.

remote.description: The Pi: RemoteProvider over an observation of the same corpus, addressed by digest, every route behind the identity Tailscale Serve stamped.

alpha.description: Paused mid-run waiting for an operator, with events, progress and artifacts on disk.

bravo.description: Never run: every detail pane has to say it has nothing rather than fail.
